LED Light-Up Barware for Wholesale

LED shot glasses and rechargeable LED ice buckets that light a table, a bar top or a VIP booth — moulded in food-grade plastic with the light module sealed into the base.

Request led & light-up barware pricing Custom logo options

About this range

Light-up serveware sells because it is visible in a dark room. The range below covers the two formats that carry a venue order: LED shot glasses sold in trays of twelve for bar service, and rechargeable LED ice buckets in 4, 8 and 12 litre sizes for bottle presentation and VIP tables. Every LED unit is a moulded food-grade plastic body with the light module and its battery sealed into the base, supplied with the charger where the model takes one, so the piece can be wiped down rather than only hand-rinsed. LED units are electrical goods: the light module, the battery format, the charger standard for your destination market and the compliance route are all confirmed per SKU before a quotation is issued. Battery format, light colour, flashing mode and the number of LEDs are configurable on volume, and the body colour, logo and packaging follow the same decoration routes as the rest of the catalogue. Send the venue format, the quantity and whether the unit has to run a full service on one charge, and we will quote against that.

LED &amp; Light-Up Barware — buyer questions

MOQ is held per SKU/model and per order route for this range — a standard bulk order, a decorated order and a gift-box build can each carry a different minimum.

What LED barware can BYF BOOM supply?

The range covers LED shot glasses supplied in trays of twelve and rechargeable LED ice buckets in 4, 8 and 12 litre sizes. Light colour, flashing mode, body colour, logo and packaging are configurable on volume.

See the range · Request a quote

Are the LED units safe for food contact and washing?

The vessel is moulded food-grade plastic and the light module with its battery is sealed into the base, so the drinking surface stays a plain moulded wall. The exact grade, its safety data sheet and the food-contact test report are issued against the SKU you order. Wipe the base rather than immersing the module.

Materials and certifications

What compliance route applies to LED drinkware?

LED units are electrical goods. The battery format, the charger standard for your destination market and the compliance documentation are confirmed per SKU before quotation. Certificate numbers are provided on request for the models that hold them.

Materials and certifications

How long does the battery run and can it be specified?

Run time depends on the model, the number of LEDs and the flashing mode. Tell us how long the unit has to stay lit across a service and the format will be specified to that, then confirmed on the pre-production sample.

Request a quote

Can I get a custom light colour or flashing pattern?

Yes on volume. Single colour, multi-colour and flashing modes are all available, and the mode is set before the bulk run and confirmed on the sample.

Customisation routes

What is the MOQ for LED barware?

MOQ is maintained per SKU and per order route. LED units carry a different minimum from plain moulded drinkware because the module and battery are bought in, so the confirmed figure is issued with the quotation.
